duplicate.title: Duplicate formulation
duplicate.subtitle: Copy this project's recipe (metadata, picks, lines) into another project. Project identity (status, owner, history) is not copied.
duplicate.mode_new_hint: Create a fresh project with a new code and name.
duplicate.mode_replace_hint: Overwrite another project's recipe. The target's current state is auto-saved as a new version first so you can roll back.
duplicate.replace_warning: The target project's recipe will be replaced with this one's. A snapshot of the target's current state is saved first — you can roll back from the version history.
duplicate.replace_confirm: I understand — replace the target's recipe
duplicate.error_generic: Something went wrong while duplicating. Please try again.

fields.name: Product name
fields.serving_size_hint_capsule: Number of capsules the customer takes per serving (typically 1–3).
fields.serving_size_hint_default: Units the customer consumes per serving.
fields.servings_per_pack_hint: Total servings the customer gets in one pack (e.g. 30, 60, 90, 120).
fields.powder_fill_weight_hint: Target mass per scoop in grams (e.g. 10 = 10g). Total per serving = this value × scoops per serving.
fields.gummy_fill_weight_hint: Target mass per gummy. Gummy base absorbs the remainder.
fields.gummy_base_item_hint: Tick every sweetener / bulking agent that goes into the gummy. The base total (target − water − actives − flavour, min 65%) is split equally across picks. Their real nutrition + compliance + label copy flow through to the spec sheet.
fields.gummy_base_item_empty: No sweeteners or bulking agents in this catalogue. Import at least one to use the gummy builder.
fields.acidity_item_hint: Tick the acid(s) used in the gummy (e.g. Citric Acid, Trisodium Citrate). The acidity total (2% of target gummy weight) is split equally across picks. Leave empty for a generic placeholder; pick items so the MRPeasy BOM is procurement-ready.
fields.acidity_item_empty: No Acidity Regulator items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Acidity Regulator' to use this picker.
fields.flavouring_item_hint: Tick every flavour that goes into the gummy (e.g. Natural Strawberry Flavour, Lemon Extract). The flavour total (0.4% of target gummy weight) is split equally across picks and the spec sheet lists them under the EU label 'Flavouring (…)'.
fields.flavouring_item_empty: No Flavouring items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Flavouring' to use this picker.
fields.colour_item_hint: Tick every colour that goes into the gummy (e.g. Beetroot Extract, Turmeric Oleoresin, Spirulina Powder). The colour total (2% of target gummy weight) is split equally across picks and the spec sheet lists them under the EU label 'Colour (…)'.
fields.colour_item_empty: No Colour items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Colour' to use this picker.
fields.glazing_item_hint: Tick every glazing agent applied to the gummy surface (e.g. Carnauba Wax, Coconut Oil, Beeswax). The glaze total (0.1% of target gummy weight) is split equally across picks and the spec sheet groups them under the EU label 'Glazing Agent (…)'.
fields.glazing_item_empty: No Glazing Agent items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Glazing Agent' to use this picker.
fields.gelling_item_hint: Tick the gelling agent(s) used as the gel matrix (e.g. Pectin, Gelatin, Agar). The gelling total (3% of target gummy weight) is split equally across picks. Leave empty for a non-gelling gummy — the gelling and premix-sweetener bands are skipped entirely.
fields.gelling_item_empty: No Gelling Agent items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Gelling Agent' to use this picker.
fields.premix_sweetener_item_hint: Tick the sweetener(s) blended with the gelling agent into the in-house 'Pectin Premix' BOM line. Pulls from the same catalogue pool as the gummy base. The premix total (6% of target) is carved out of the gummy base remainder.
fields.premix_sweetener_item_empty: No Sweeteners or Bulking Agents in this catalogue. Import at least one to use this picker.
fields.mcc_carrier_item_hint: Tick the catalogue items used as the structural carrier (Microcrystalline Cellulose). The MCC total — capsule remainder or tablet 20% — is split equally across picks and the spec sheet emits one row per pick with the picked item's nutrition + compliance + label copy. Optional: empty leaves a generic 'Microcrystalline Cellulose (Carrier)' placeholder and a soft warning.
fields.mcc_carrier_item_empty: No Bulking Agent items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Bulking Agent' to use this picker.
fields.dcp_carrier_item_hint: Tick the catalogue items used as the Dicalcium Phosphate carrier. The DCP total (10% of total active) is split equally across picks. Optional: empty leaves a generic 'Dicalcium Phosphate' placeholder and a soft warning.
fields.dcp_carrier_item_empty: No Bulking Agent items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Bulking Agent' to use this picker.
fields.anti_caking_item_hint: Tick the items used as the anti-caking band (typically Magnesium Stearate + Silicon Dioxide). Contribution is dynamic per pick: silica-only fires the 0.4% silica band, stearate-only fires the 1.0% lubricant band, both light up the full 1.4% of total active. Optional: empty leaves no anti-caking band on the formulation at all.
fields.anti_caking_item_empty: No Anti-caking Agent items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Anti-caking Agent' to use this picker.
fields.powder_acidity_item_hint: Tick the acidity regulators for this powder (typically Trisodium Citrate + Citric Acid). The combined acidity total (35 mg per gram of powder by default) is split equally across picks; the spec sheet emits one 'Acidity Regulator (picked names)' row. Optional: empty list = no acidity band at all.
fields.powder_acidity_item_empty: No Acidity Regulator items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Acidity Regulator' to use this picker.
fields.powder_carrier_item_hint: Tick the items used as the structural carrier on this powder — typically Maltodextrin or a similar bulking agent. The carrier total fills the remainder of the sachet after the actives + other excipient bands; picks split it equally. Empty list = no carrier band on the formulation (the sachet may be under-filled, which is your call).
fields.powder_carrier_item_empty: No Carrier / Bulking Agent items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Carrier' or 'Bulking Agent' to use this picker.
fields.powder_flavouring_item_hint: Tick every flavour for this powder (e.g. Natural Strawberry Flavour, Lemon Extract). The 0.25 mg/ml × water volume flavour total splits equally across picks; the spec sheet lists them under the EU label 'Flavouring (…)'. Empty list keeps the generic placeholder row.
fields.powder_flavouring_item_empty: No Flavouring items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Flavouring' to use this picker.
fields.powder_sweetener_item_hint: Tick the sweetener(s) for this powder (Sucralose, Stevia, Steviol, etc.). The 0.06 mg/ml × water volume sweetener total splits equally across picks; the spec sheet lists them under 'Sweetener (…)'. Powder-only — gummies use the Gummy Base picker for their sweeteners.
fields.powder_sweetener_item_empty: No Sweeteners in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Sweeteners' to use this picker.
fields.powder_colour_item_hint: Tick every colour for this powder (Beetroot Extract, Turmeric Oleoresin, Spirulina Powder, etc.). The 0.04 mg/ml × water volume colour total splits equally across picks; the spec sheet lists them under 'Colour (…)'.
fields.powder_colour_item_empty: No Colour items in this catalogue. Tag at least one raw material with use_as = 'Colour' to use this picker.
fields.water_volume_ml_hint: Flavour-system mg (acidity regulator, sweetener, flavouring and colour) scale linearly against this volume. Reference: 500ml.
fields.directions_of_use_hint: Short instruction the customer follows. Format: "Take / Chew / Mix [quantity] [with food / with water / daily] …". Keep it to a single sentence.
fields.directions_of_use_placeholder_gummy: Chew 2 gummies daily, preferably with food.
fields.directions_of_use_placeholder_powder: Mix 1 scoop (10 g) with 500 ml water. Shake well. Drink once daily.
fields.directions_of_use_placeholder_default: e.g. Take 1 capsule with food, daily.
fields.suggested_dosage_hint: The per-day dose for labelling. Format: "[quantity] [unit] per day" — this is the number the NRV calculation uses.
fields.appearance_hint: What the finished product looks like. Format: "[colour] [shape/size] [texture]". Gets printed verbatim on the spec sheet — avoid marketing language.
fields.appearance_placeholder_tablet: White round tablet, 10 mm diameter, smooth coating
fields.disintegration_spec_hint: Time for the dose to break down in water at 37 °C. Must match the test method on the QC sheet. Leave blank for gummies / powders / liquids (no disintegration requirement).

mrpeasy_picker.hint: Type a code or product name and press Search to look it up in MRPEasy. Pick a row to autofill the code and name. Leave blank to enter them manually.
mrpeasy_picker.locked_hint: Code and product name are managed via MRPEasy on this workspace. Use the search above to pick the matching product — the fields will autofill.

builder.picker_empty: No matches. Try a different search.
builder.picker_none_added: No ingredients yet. Pick one on the left.

builder.no_raw_material_purity: This raw material is missing purity / extract ratio data — the formulation math cannot compute its mg/serving until you fix the source catalogue row.

codes.fill_shortfall: Add a carrier / bulking agent to reach the target
codes.capsule_too_large: Too large for any standard capsule
codes.pick_capsule_shell: Pick a capsule shell to compute
codes.capsule_shell_missing_max_weight: Picked shell has no Fill capacity (mg) attribute — set it on PSP
codes.capsule_shell_max_weight_from_map: Using standard fill capacity — set attributes.max_weight_mg on the picked shell for a precise value
codes.mcc_carrier_unpicked: MCC carrier not picked — spec sheet will use the generic placeholder
codes.dcp_carrier_unpicked: DCP carrier not picked — spec sheet will use the generic placeholder

warnings.fill_shortfall: Recipe is below the target fill weight — add a carrier / bulking agent line to make it up.
warnings.fill_overshoot: Recipe is over the target fill weight — drop actives or raise the target.
warnings.capsule_too_large: Recipe exceeds the largest standard capsule — drop actives or split the dose across more servings.
warnings.pick_capsule_shell: Tick a capsule shell — compute needs the shell's capsule_size + max_weight_mg attributes.
warnings.capsule_shell_missing_max_weight: The picked capsule shell has no recognisable capsule_size attribute, so compute can't pick a fallback fill capacity from the standard table. Edit the item on PSP to set attributes.capsule_size (size_0, single_00, etc.) or attributes.max_weight_mg.
warnings.capsule_shell_max_weight_from_map: The picked capsule shell has capsule_size set but no explicit attributes.max_weight_mg — compute is using the standard fill capacity for that size. Set attributes.max_weight_mg on the PSP row for a supplier-specific value.
warnings.gummy_base_below_floor: Gummy base would fall below the structural floor — drop actives or raise the target so the gel can set.
warnings.powder_flavour_water_volume_missing: No water volume entered — set the per-serving water volume so the flavour-system bands can dose.
warnings.powder_acidity_rate_missing: Acidity item "{name}" has no Powder Water Dose set on the raw material.
warnings.powder_flavouring_rate_missing: Flavouring item "{name}" has no Powder Water Dose set on the raw material.
warnings.powder_sweetener_rate_missing: Sweetener item "{name}" has no Powder Water Dose set on the raw material.
warnings.powder_colour_rate_missing: Colour item "{name}" has no Powder Water Dose set on the raw material.
warnings.item_missing_use_as: Ingredient "{name}" has no "Used As" classification — set it on the raw material so the spec sheet groups it correctly.

mrpeasy_bom.title: MRPeasy BOM
mrpeasy_bom.hint: Per-1 kg breakdown for procurement. Pectin Premix collapses the gelling agent + premix sweetener into a single in-house BOM line — the label declaration still lists the components separately. On gummies the actives also collapse into a single 'Active Powder' line; the sub-BOM below breaks the pre-blend down ingredient-by-ingredient.
mrpeasy_bom.print_subtitle: Bill of materials per 1 kg of finished product.
mrpeasy_bom.empty_hint: Add at least one ingredient or set a target fill weight to compute the BOM.
mrpeasy_bom.main_title: Main BOM (per 1 kg of finished product)
mrpeasy_bom.main_hint: Final assembly. Rows tagged Pre-blend collapse a separate sub-BOM (e.g. Active Powder above) into one procurement line.

active_powder.title: Active Powder BOM
active_powder.hint: In-house pre-blend that ships into the main gummy BOM as a single 'Active Powder' line. Quantities below are per 1 kg of the Active Powder itself, not per 1 kg of finished gummy.
active_powder.print_subtitle: Active Powder pre-blend — per 1 kg of the actives blend.
active_powder.total: Total per 1 kg of Active Powder

line_overrides.title: Per-line overrides
line_overrides.hint: Override the catalogue's purity / overage / extract ratio for this formulation only. Leave a field blank to use the catalogue value (shown as a placeholder).

overrides.title: Excipient ratios
overrides.hint: Per-band rates that drive the auto-filled excipient mg. Edit any value to override the default; press Enter or tab away to commit. Persists into the next saved version.
overrides.empty_hint: Pick anti-caking, flavouring, sweetener, colour, or a carrier in the pickers above to expose the editable rates here. Acidity dose rates are set per item on the catalogue's Powder Water Dose column.

basis.per_g_powder: for every gram of finished powder

compliance.unknown_tooltip: {count} ingredient(s) have no value set. Chip fades when any aggregation answer is held without confidence.

versions.title: Version history
versions.rollback_confirm_body: The current working state will be replaced with the snapshot from v{version}. The rollback itself is saved as a new version so nothing is lost.
